name: Lake O'Hara Alpine Circuit
why: A high route round the lakes of Lake O'Hara, over Wiwaxy Gap and the ledges above Lake Oesa and the Opabin Plateau, in one of the finest corners of the Rockies.
book: The 11 km road is closed to cars: Parks Canada bus by random draw in March (then leftover seats until 3:30 pm the day before), mid-June to early October. Daily cap of visitors; the alternative is walking the road.
water: Water at Le Relais shelter; streams on the way (filter).
dangers: Exposed scrambling and drops on Wiwaxy Gap and Yukness Ledge: take the lower routes if unsure.
Snow on the high routes until July.
Grizzly bears: routes close for bear activity.
turnaround: Skip the high routes in rain, snow or fog.
